votes.motion: Continue the Notice of Intent hearing by Christian and Allison Martin for 127 Chase Road to September 21.
votes.quote: ml/jv m/s to continue the meeting to sept 21. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Continue the Notice of Intent hearing by Ryan Proctor for 451 Townsend Harbor Road until September 21.
votes.quote: jv/cc m/s to continue until september 21. roll call vote, unanimous to approve (ml recused)

votes.motion: Make a negative #3 determination for the Request for Determination of Applicability by Andrew Leblanc at 362 Townsend Harbor Road.
votes.quote: jv/ml moved to make a negative determination #3 for the project. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Continue the Request for Determination of Applicability by Nicholas Pirro at 408 Electric Avenue to September 21st.
votes.quote: ml/jv m/s to continue to september 21st. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Continue the Request for Determination of Applicability by Brian Haas at 509 Townsend Harbor Road to September 21st.
votes.quote: ml/cc m/s to continue to september 21st. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Approve the Notice of Intent by Marsden Engineering at 37 Spring Street as designed, with a standard order of conditions.
votes.quote: jv/ml m/s to approve the project as designed with a standard order of conditions. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Continue the Notice of Intent by Fitchburg Land property Owner LLC at 260 Fahlulah Road to October 5th.
votes.quote: ml/jv m/s to continue to october 5th. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Require applicants to pay advertising fees directly to the newspapers.
votes.quote: cc/ml m/s to have applicants pay advertising fees directly to the papers. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Approve $100 to purchase a used water tank for the pollinator habitat and $20 for 8 cinderblocks for the water tank.
votes.quote: ml/jv m/s to approve $100 to purchase a used water tank for the pollinator habitat and $20 for 8 cinderblocks for the water tank. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Approve the $495 Ransford Environmental quote for an exterminator at 123 Hollis Road.
votes.quote: ml/rt moved to approve the $495 ransford quote. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.

votes.motion: Approve a $700 purchase order for signs from SmartSign, paid from the Timber Rights Revolving Fund.

jv/ml m/s to adjourn the meeting. roll call vote, unanimous to approve.
